city_served.value: Served — one of the 24 South Carolina towns confirmed served (Brand Guide Section E)

local_context.value: In the 2020 census 21.2% of Walterboro residents were 65+ (17.9% in 2010); 2,689 housing units (2020) and historic homes dating back to 1820; mean July high about 90.5 F and about 51.4 inches of precipitation a year.

neighborhoods.value: Catholic Hill (rural area, southern Walterboro, once Thompson's Crossroads); Hickory Valley (original settlement site)

place_entities.value: HCA Healthcare Colleton Hospital (Walterboro); Colleton County Courthouse (Robert Mills design); University of South Carolina Salkehatchie; Lowcountry Regional Airport
place_entities.source: https://www.hcahealthcarecolleton.com/ (HCA Healthcare Colleton Hospital, read 2026-10-14) · https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Colleton_County_Courthouse (Wikipedia, read 2026-10-14) · https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_South_Carolina_Salkehatchie (Wikipedia, read 2026-10-14) · https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lowcountry_Regional_Airport (Wikipedia, read 2026-10-14)

permit_office.value: City of Walterboro posts its own Building Permit Application (walterborosc.org); Colleton County Planning and Development (31 Klein St, Walterboro; 843-549-1709) is the county office. Official pages do not state which office issues inside city limits - confirm by phone
